sections.title: Den of Trials
sections.note: Added in Ver. 2.0.0: 40 floors in eight zones of five, ending with three Shadow Links.

items.name: Forest Zone
items.howTo: Floors B1–B5. Defeat every enemy on each floor, then open the safe room's chests. Items: Bow, Boomerang, Fire Gloves.
items.reward: Materials: 2 × one of Blob Jelly, Armos Spirit or Tektite Shell, or 1 × one of Sweet Shroom, Blin Bling or Gohma's Eye
items.notes: Opens after nine levels or challenges are cleared: talk to The Great Tripini in Hytopia. You start with only one Fairy. Based on the Woodlands. Clearing a zone lets you start from the next one later; a party can only start from a zone every member has reached. The safe room also holds a chest with a Fairy.

items.reward: Materials: 2 × one of Fresh Kelp, Zora Scale or Hytopian Silk, or 1 × one of Aqua Crown, Octorok Sucker or Fairy Dust
items.notes: Based on the Riverside. Clearing a zone lets you start from the next one later; a party can only start from a zone every member has reached. The safe room also holds a chest with a Fairy.

items.reward: Fierce Deity Armor (first clear). Materials: 2 × one of Cucco Feathers, Carmine Pearl or Sky Dragon Tail, or 1 × one of Pretty Plume, Mock Fairy or Aurora Stone
items.notes: Based on the Sky Realm. Download Play guests can't get the Fierce Deity Armor.
